The *Vāruṇidūsakajātaka* (Ja 47) is a canonical birth story in the Pali Jātaka collection [SuttaCentral]. Set during the Buddha's stay at Jetavana, the narrative was delivered in reference to an individual who spoiled spirits or liquor, opening with the verse incipit “’Tis knowledge” [SuttaCentral]. On SuttaCentral, the text is translated into English by Bhikkhu Sujato as *The One Who Spoiled the Liquor*, with six translations across four languages recorded [SuttaCentral].
